resources.string:
HaoHao IME · September 6, 2026

Input and learning: Rime processes input on this device. When input history is enabled, My words stores recent eligible words and counts. Favorites and learning meanings are saved only when you choose them. Learning records contain words, confirmed meanings, sources and review progress, without chat context. This vocabulary database and candidate cloud cache are excluded from Android automatic backup. Clear history keeps favorites and learning; Clear all removes them after confirmation.

Cloud translation: after consent and cloud configuration, enabled cloud candidates may send visible candidate text to the selected provider. Sentence translation sends text you explicitly select for translation. Requests may include authorization credentials; providers also receive ordinary network information such as your IP address. Local-only candidates do not use cloud translation. Password and no-personalized-learning fields are excluded according to editor flags. Leaving the input view cancels pending requests; data already sent cannot be recalled.

Other features: dictionary learning, clipboard history and manual configuration export follow their separate settings. English speech requires separate consent and a manual tap. Only selected English is sent over HTTPS to HaoHao’s speech server and Tencent Cloud. No chat history or microphone is accessed. The gateway stores hashed source rate counters and daily character totals, not text, audio or credentials in application logs. Private audio cache is limited to 50MB and seven days, uses least-recently-used eviction and is excluded from backup; no separate sentence text is stored. My words lets you clear the cache or revoke online speech consent; cached audio still works offline. Listening does not retranslate or save sentences to vocabulary. Online speech testing ends after September 30, 2026. Android 15 and later temporarily display a playback status notification without sentence text. Stopping or leaving the page ends playback. No account sync or automatic learning reminders are provided in this version.

Cloud providers apply their own data policies. Review them before enabling cloud features.
